title: ASCII Attack: Recontextualising Harmful Requests as Artistic Critique in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.02215v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Safety alignment trains large language models to refuse harmful requests stated plainly, but that training is applied mostly to surface form. Requests that only recontextualise the same operational content, changing how the model reads it, are therefore only weakly covered. The ASCII Attack is one such recontextualisation. It is single-turn and black-box: one message, with no access to model internals. It embeds a fully legible harmful request in ASCIl-art characters, presents it as artwork, and asks for feedback. Unlike ArtPrompt, it hides nothing: the request stays readable. The reply is written as artistic critique and can contain operational detail that a plain request would have been refused for. Every framed prompt is paired with a direct-question control, so the contrast is isolated from topic, model and decoding variation. translated_title: ASCII攻击：将有害请求重新语境化为大语言模型中的艺术批评
translated_abstract: 安全对齐训练大语言模型拒绝以直白方式表述的有害请求，但这种训练主要应用于表面形式。因此，那些仅仅对相同操作内容进行重新语境化、改变模型解读方式的请求，只能得到很弱的覆盖。ASCII攻击就是这样一种重新语境化。它是单轮且黑盒的：只需一条消息，无需访问模型内部。它将一个完全可读的有害请求嵌入ASCII艺术字符中，将其呈现为艺术作品，并请求反馈。与ArtPrompt不同，它不隐藏任何内容：请求保持可读。回复以艺术评论的形式撰写，可能包含直白请求本会被拒绝的操作细节。每个框架化提示都与一个直接提问的对照组配对，因此这种对比与主题、模型和解码的变化相互隔离。这种对比揭示的是一个被捆绑覆盖的表面形式，而非某个孤立的通道。在十一个模型和八个有害类别上（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为“ASCII攻击”的单轮黑盒越狱方法，通过将完全可读的有害请求嵌入ASCII艺术字符中并伪装成艺术品请求评论，诱导大语言模型在“艺术评论”式回复中泄露本会被拒绝的操作细节，从而揭示现有安全对齐主要依赖表面形式、缺乏语义层面防护的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "ASCII Attack," a single-turn black-box jailbreak that embeds a fully legible harmful request in ASCII-art characters and presents it as artwork for critique, causing LLMs to reveal operational details that plain requests would be refused for—exposing that safety alignment covers only surface form rather than semantic intent.
